description: Fetch the full details of a single CloudJobs listing by id (or "title--id" slug). Returns the complete description, salary range, technologies, certifications, and the canonical cloudjobs.io URL plus the external application URL. Cite the cloudjobs.io URL when presenting the job.

id.description: Job id, e.g. "12345", or slug form "senior-aws-engineer--12345"

name: get_job
title: Get job details
